en.tashayyu: 2 – al-Ḥusayn b. al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad b. Ayyūb b. Shammūn.

They have weakened him, but according to me he is thiqa.  However there is discussion in regards to those who narrate from him.  And his father, al-Qāsim, was from the noteworthy of the Shīʿa, however nothing has been narrated from him.
